categories.name: Pati Patni
jokes:
Patni: “Aaj kya banau?”
Pati: “Kuch bhi bana lo.”
Patni: “Rajma?”
Pati: “Nahi yaar.”
Patni: “Bhindi?”
Pati: “Kal hi toh khaayi thi.”
Patni: “Toh kya banau?”
Pati: “Kuch bhi bana lo.”

Biwi: “Main is dress mein moti lag rahi hoon kya?”
Pati sirf 3 second chup raha.

Ab woh 3 second ki saza 3 hafte se kaat raha hai.

Shaadi se pehle: “Tumhare liye chaand taare tod laaunga.”
Shaadi ke baad: “Dhaniya laana bhool gaya, kal le aaunga.”

Dost: “Bhabhi ne 6 mahine se tujhse baat nahi ki?”
Pati: “Nahi yaar.”
Dost: “Kyun?”
Pati: “Main beech mein tokna nahi chahta.”

Pati WhatsApp pe: “Kahan ho?”
Patni: “Mall mein.”
Pati: “Card mera hai?”
Patni: “Haan.”
Pati: “Toh technically mall mein main hoon, bas body tumhari hai.”

Patni ne pati ka phone check kiya. Kuch nahi mila.

Ab woh isliye naraz hai ki “itna saaf phone kisi seedhe aadmi ka nahi hota, zaroor sab delete kiya hai.”

Pati: “Jaanu, aaj khana main banaunga.”
Patni: “Awww! Kya banaoge?”
Pati: “Zomato pe order.”

Patni: “Tum mujhe pehle jaisa pyaar nahi karte.”
Pati: “Pehle EMI bhi nahi thi, jaanu.”
Shaadi ke baad sher bhi ghar mein ghuste hi pehla sawaal poochhta hai: “Chappal bahar utaarun ya andar?”

Biwi naraz hoke maayke chali gayi.
Pati ne status lagaya: “Azaadi ka Amrit Mahotsav 🇮🇳”

2 minute baad saas ka call aaya.

Patni: “Tum mujhse kitna pyaar karte ho?”
Pati: “Jitna tum soch bhi nahi sakti.”
Patni: “Achha? Toh ghar mere naam kar do.”
Pati: “Itna bhi nahi.”

Ladke shaadi se pehle sher hote hain.
Shaadi ke baad bhi sher hi rehte hain…
bas circus wale.

Patni: “Pehli baar milke main tumhe kaisi lagi thi?”
Pati: “Bilkul Netflix ke free trial jaisi. Pehle sab free lag raha tha, baad mein pata chala har mahine bharna padega.”

Patni: “Doctor ne bola hai mujhe hawa-paani badalna chahiye.”
Pati: “Theek hai, kal hi naya pankha aur naya RO lagwa deta hoon.”

Biwiyan do type ki hoti hain:
1. Jinhe shak hai.
2. Jinhe yakeen hai, bas saboot dhoond rahi hain.

Doctor: “Shaadi ke baad aapka weight itna kaise badh gaya?”
Patni: “Pati din raat khilata hai.”
Doctor: “Kya khilata hai?”
Patni: “Kasam.”

Pati: “Bhagwan, shaadi se pehle mujhe akal kyun nahi di?”
Bhagwan: “Beta, akal hoti toh shaadi kaun karta?”

Patni: “Mere birthday pe kuch special karna.”
Pati ne us din bartan dho diye.

Patni 3 din tak sabko bolti rahi: “Inhone mujhe surprise diya.”
Pati 3 din tak sochta raha: “Ab har saal karna padega.”

Pati-patni ka WhatsApp chat:
Patni: “Aate waqt doodh, sabzi, aata, dahi, bread aur ek Maggi le aana.”
Pati: “Ok.”
Patni: “Aur haan, I love you.”
Pati: “Woh bhi dukaan pe milega?”
Biwi ka “Kuch nahi hua” sunke jo aadmi sach mein maan leta hai, uska shaadi ke baad koi bhavishya nahi hai.

Patni: “Main tumhare liye kya hoon?”
Pati: “Meri poori duniya.”
Patni: “Toh duniya ghumane kab le chaloge?”
Pati: “Duniya gol hai jaanu, ghoom ke yahin aana hai.”

Pati: “Bina bataaye maayke kyun chali gayi?”
Patni: “Bataake jaati toh tum khushi se pagal ho jaate.”

Patni: “Agar main kho gayi toh kya karoge?”
Pati: “Akhbaar mein ad dunga.”
Patni: “Kya likhoge?”
Pati: “Dhoondhne wale ko 1000 inaam. Rakh lene wale ko 5000.”

Pati: “Ghar ka head main hoon.”
Patni: “Bilkul. Aur main neck hoon. Head wahi ghoomta hai jahan neck chahti hai.”

Patni subah se naraz: “Raat sapne mein tumne mujhe dhokha diya.”
Pati: “Sapna tumne dekha, saza mujhe kyun?”

Shaadi ke 10 saal baad pati-patni ek doosre ki baat bina bole samajh jaate hain.
Isiliye ab baat hi nahi hoti.

Patni: “Agar main tumhe chhod ke chali jaaun toh?”
Pati: “Pakka?”
Patni: “Pakka kya?”
Pati: “Kuch nahi, bas plan bana raha tha.”

Patni: “Tum mere liye kuch bhi karoge?”
Pati: “Haan, kuch bhi.”
Patni: “Toh aaj meri mummy ko 2 hafte ke liye bula lo.”
Pati: “Jaanu, 'kuch bhi' ki bhi ek limit hoti hai.”

categories.name: Desi Mummy Papa
jokes: Mummy ka “5 minute mein khana ready” aur Papa ka “bas 5 minute mein nikal rahe hain” — Indian Standard Time ke do sabse bade jhooth.

Mera phone 2% pe bhi chal jaata hai.
Mummy ka phone 96% pe: “Beta dekh na, iski battery ko kya ho gaya.”

Mummy: “Birthday pe kya chahiye?”
Main (style mein): “Kuch nahi.”
Mummy: “Theek hai.”

Aur sach mein kuch nahi mila. Desi parents sarcasm nahi samajhte, seedha implement karte hain.
Indian mummy ki chappal duniya ka pehla Bluetooth weapon thi — haath mein nahi hoti thi, phir bhi seedha target pe lagti thi.

Papa: “Sharma ji ke bete ke 95% aaye.”
Beta: “Sharma ji ki salary bhi 3 lakh hai.”

Us din ke baad ghar mein Sharma ji ka naam nahi liya gaya.

Duniya ka sabse khatarnak sentence:
“Agar maine aake dhoondh liya na…”

Papa ko phone chalana sikhao: “Papa, ye button dabao.”
5 minute baad: “Tumhari wajah se sab kharab ho gaya.”

Guest aate hi mummy ki awaaz 3 level meethi ho jaati hai.
Guest jaate hi: “Ye bartan kisne chhode? Haan? Bhoot ne?”

Parents 20 ki umar tak: “Ladkiyon ke chakkar mein mat padna, padhai karo.”
Parents 25 ki umar mein: “Koi pasand hai toh bata de, warna hum dhoondhein?”

Ek raat mein ladki kahan se laaun?

Papa: “Humare zamane mein 10 rupaye mein poora bazaar le aate the.”
Beta: “Ab nahi kar sakte papa, har dukaan pe CCTV laga hai.”

Mummy ki dawai list:
Sardard — haldi doodh
Bukhaar — haldi doodh
Chot — haldi doodh
Breakup — haldi doodh pi aur padhai kar.

“Dost ke ghar ja raha hoon” bolne ke baad mummy ko dena padta hai:
Dost ka naam, papa ka naam, address, ghar ka number, wapas kab aaoge.

Isse aasaan toh passport ban jaata hai.

Papa AC chala ke: “26 pe rakho, bill aata hai.”
Phir khud kambal odh ke so jaate hain.

Mummy: “Jab main teri umar ki thi, poora ghar sambhaal leti thi.”
Beta: “Mummy, tab aapke paas Instagram nahi tha.”
Indian ghar mein “Room saaf kar le” ka matlab hai: mummy khud saaf karegi aur 3 din tak taane degi.

Mummy: “Kitni der se phone chala raha hai!”
Main: “Mummy, padhai kar raha hoon.”
Mummy: “Achha? Toh hans kyun raha hai?”
Papa ka WhatsApp: “Good morning 🌹🙏” — 47 forward, 3 fake news, 1 video jisme Nasa ne Om ki awaaz suni.

Mummy kuch dhoondh nahi paaye: “Tune kahan rakha?”
Main kuch dhoondh nahi paaun: “Aankhein khol ke dhoondh, saamne hi hai.”

Mummy se bolo “Main thak gaya”: “Kaam kya karta hai tu jo thakega?”
Papa se bolo: “Humari umar mein aake dekhna.”

Indian ghar mein thakne ka adhikar sirf ghar ke bade logon ko hai.

Kuch bhi kharab ho jaaye, papa ka ek hi dialogue: “Maine pehle hi bola tha.”
Unhone kabhi kuch nahi bola tha.

Mummy ke do mode:
1. “Khana kha le, kitna patla ho gaya hai.”
2. “Kitna khaayega, mota ho jayega.”

Dono 10 minute ke andar.

Papa gaadi chalaate waqt: “Sab pagal hain sadak pe.”
Main chalaaun toh: “Tu pagal hai kya?”

Mummy: “Naha le.”
Main: “Thand hai.”
Mummy: “Garam paani le le.”
Main: “Phir garmi lagegi.”
Mummy ne chappal uthayi.

Main naha liya. Indian ghar ka asli geyser chappal hai.

Papa: “Kitne ka liya?”
Main: “2000.”
Papa: “Lut gaya, 500 ka milta hai.”

Asli price 5000 tha. Tab se main har cheez ka aadha daam batata hoon.

Mummy ka WhatsApp gyaan: “Beta, raat ko phone sirhane rakh ke sone se cancer hota hai.”
Aur ye message unhone raat 1 baje, phone sirhane rakh ke bheja.

Bachpan mein: “Bada hoke kya banega?” — “Pilot.”
Ab rishtedaar: “Naukri lagi?” — “Abhi nahi.”
Mummy: “Pilot banne wala tha na, ab toh zameen pe bhi nahi chal raha.”

categories.name: Office & Corporate
jokes:
Boss: “Hum yahan ek family ki tarah hain.”
Translation: Salary kam milegi aur Sunday ko bhi call aayega.

HR: “Aapki sabse badi weakness?”
Candidate: “Honesty.”
HR: “Mujhe nahi lagta honesty weakness hai.”
Candidate: “Mujhe ghanta farak nahi padta aap kya sochti hain.”

Manager: “Aapka kaam bahut achha raha, isliye 4% hike.”
Main: “Aur agar bura hota?”
Manager: “Tab bhi 4%, bas feedback ke saath.”
“Quick call?” — corporate ka sabse bada jhooth. Quick call 1 ghante chalti hai aur end mein bolte hain “let's connect again tomorrow.”
Resignation ke baad wala notice period — insaan zindagi mein itna khush kabhi nahi hota. Ye naukri nahi, parole hai.

Salary aur weekend mein kya common hai?
Dono aate hi chale jaate hain.

Boss: “Roz late kyun aate ho?”
Main: “Sir, traffic.”
Boss: “Roz traffic?”
Main: “Sir, Bengaluru hai. Traffic roz aata hai, main bhi roz late aata hoon. Consistency hai.”
Work from home ka sabse bada fayda: camera off karke “Ji sir, bilkul sir” bolte hue Maggi bana lo.

LinkedIn: “Humbled and honoured to announce…”
Asli matlab: Naukri mil gayi, ab 2 saal baad wahi aadmi “toxic culture” pe post karega.

Client: “Bas chhota sa change hai.”
Manager: “Ek din ka kaam hai.”
Developer ne jo suna: “Poora project dobara likho, Sunday ko.”
Salary credit hone ke 3 din baad account dekh ke aisa lagta hai jaise kisi ne Ctrl+Z daba diya ho.

Interviewer: “5 saal baad khud ko kahan dekhte ho?”
Candidate: “Aapki kursi pe.”
Interviewer: “Excuse me?”
Candidate: “Sir, aap tab tak resign kar chuke honge, kisi ko toh baithna padega.”
Monday ko office jaana aur sasural jaana — dono mein ek hi feeling hoti hai: “Bas kuch ghante ki baat hai, jhel lenge.”
Meeting jo email ho sakti thi, uske baad ek aur meeting hoti hai ye discuss karne ke liye ki pichhli meeting itni lambi kyun thi.

Boss: “Weekend pe kya plan hai?”
Main: “Kuch nahi sir.”
Boss: “Badhiya, toh Saturday ko thoda kaam dekh lena.”

Us din seekha: boss ko kabhi “kuch nahi” mat bolna.

Indian corporate ke 3 shabd jo kabhi nahi badalte:
“Noted.”
“Will check and revert.”
“As discussed.”

Aur in teeno ka matlab: kuch nahi hoga.

Office mein do type ke log hote hain:
1. Jo kaam karte hain.
2. Jo kaam karte hue dikhte hain.

Promotion hamesha doosre wale ka hota hai.

Appraisal se pehle manager itna pyaar se baat karta hai jaise rishta aaya ho.
Appraisal ke baad: Seen 11:42 PM.

Boss: “Out of the box socho.”
Maine socha.
Aur resign kar diya.

Job description: “Fast-paced environment.”
Translation: Koi plan nahi hai, sab jagah aag lagi hui hai, aap bhi aa jao.
“Competitive salary” ka matlab: itni kam ki tum har saal doosri companies mein interview dekar compete karte rahoge.

Main: “Sir, aaj bukhaar hai, leave chahiye.”
Boss: “Laptop se kaam kar lo, bukhaar mein dimaag toh chalta hai.”
Bhai, dimaag chalta toh is company mein hota?

IT employee ka sapna: ek din aisa aaye jab koi “small change” na aaye.
Us din ko retirement kehte hain.
Office ki coffee machine sabse zyada kaam karti hai, sabka mood sambhaalti hai, aur use bhi kabhi appraisal nahi milta.

categories.name: Dosti Yaari
jokes: Asli dost woh hai jo tumhe girne se nahi bachata. Pehle hasta hai, video banata hai, group pe daalta hai, phir uthata hai.

Dost: “Bhai paise chahiye.”
Main: “Kitne?”
Dost: “Jitne tu de sake.”
Main: “Zero.”
Dost: “Theek hai, 500 de de.”

Har group mein ek dost hota hai jo bolta hai “Main nahi peeta.”
Raat 2 baje wahi ex ko call karke ro raha hota hai.

Dost ko photo bhejo: “Kaisa lag raha hoon?”
Reply: “Bhai tu rehne de.”

Isse imaandar review toh Amazon pe bhi nahi milta.
Dost se udhaar wapas maango aur ex ko message karo — dono ka reply ek hi aata hai: “Seen.”

Group chat: “Is saal pakka Goa chalenge!”

7 saal ho gaye. Goa abhi bhi group chat mein hi hai.

Kanjoos dost: “Bill split karte hain.”
2 minute baad: “Maine starter nahi khaaya, mera 37 rupaye kam karo.”

Ladkiyan apni best friend ko bolti hain “Babe 💕”.
Ladke apne best friend ko bolte hain “Abe kamine”.

Matlab dono ka ek hi hai.

Exam se pehle dost: “Bhai maine kuch nahi padha.”
Result: 92%.

Asli dushman Pakistan nahi, yahi hai.
Dost ki shaadi mein naachna aur dost ke breakup pe party — dono mein energy exactly same hoti hai.

Dost: “Bhai tera ex ki shaadi ho gayi.”
Main: “Toh? Mujhe kya.”
Dost: “Ladka tujhse zyada smart hai.”
Main: “Ab mujhe farak padta hai.”
Dosti ka asli test tab hota hai jab tum uske ghar jao aur uski mummy bole: “Tu hi hai na jo isse bigaadta hai?”
Dost ki bike leke jaao toh petrol khatam karke wapas karna — ye dosti ka unwritten rule hai.

Ek dost hota hai jo har plan pe bolta hai “Main pakka aaunga.”
Aur har baar plan wale din: “Bhai ghar pe kuch kaam aa gaya.”
Uska ghar pe kaam hai: sona.

Dost: “Bhai, tu aaj bahut achha lag raha hai.”
Translation: Kuch chahiye.
Asli dost woh nahi jo mushkil mein saath de. Asli dost woh hai jo mushkil mein bhi tumhara itna mazak udaaye ki tum hans pado.
Hostel ka rule: Maggi ek packet, chammach paanch, aur jo late aaya uske hisse mein sirf masala.

Dost: “Bas 10 minute mein pahunch raha hoon.”
Asli status: Abhi naha bhi nahi raha.

Bachpan ke dost ka number phone mein “Rahul” se nahi, “Rahul Kamina” se save hota hai.
Aur yahi pyaar hai.

Dost ki sabse badi madad: “Bhai tu tension mat le, sab theek ho jayega.”
Phir woh khud bhi tension mein so jaata hai.

Dost: “Bhai sach bata, main mota ho gaya hoon kya?”
Main: “Nahi bhai.”
Dost: “Sach bata.”
Main: “Haan bhai, Google Maps pe dikhne laga hai.”

categories.name: Pappu Golu
jokes:
Teacher: “Pappu, tumhare paas 10 aam hain. Main 5 maang loon toh kitne bachenge?”
Pappu: “10.”
Teacher: “Kaise?”
Pappu: “Main doonga hi nahi.”

Pappu doctor se: “Doctor saab, chai peeta hoon toh aankh mein dard hota hai.”
Doctor: “Pehle cup se chammach nikaal liya karo.”
Pappu ne naukri ke form mein “Expected Salary” ke aage likha: “Haan.”

Interviewer: “Aap jaldi calculation karte ho?”
Golu: “Ji sir, bahut jaldi.”
Interviewer: “17 x 24?”
Golu: “50.”
Interviewer: “Ye toh bilkul galat hai.”
Golu: “Par jaldi tha na sir.”

Pappu: “Papa, main ek din bada aadmi banunga.”
Papa: “Bada toh tu ho gaya beta, aadmi banna baaki hai.”

Raat ko Pappu ke ghar chor ghusa.
Pappu: “Kya dhoondh rahe ho?”
Chor: “Paise.”
Pappu: “Ruko, main bhi saath dhoondhta hoon. Mujhe bhi aaj tak nahi mile.”

Pappu ne Google pe search kiya: “Kya Google galat ho sakta hai?”
Google: “Kya aapka matlab tha: Kya Pappu galat ho sakta hai?”

Golu: “Bhagwan, 10 crore ki lottery laga do, aadha tumhe chadha dunga.”
Agle din lottery lagi: 5 crore.
Golu: “Waah bhagwan, apna hissa pehle hi kaat liya!”

Pappu ATM se nikal ke chillaya: “Mere 500 kat gaye!”
Guard: “Kaise?”
Pappu: “Pehle balance 1000 tha, ab 500 hai.”
Guard: “Beech mein kya kiya?”
Pappu: “500 nikaale.”

Teacher: “Pappu, sabse purana jaanwar kaunsa hai?”
Pappu: “Zebra, ma'am.”
Teacher: “Kyun?”
Pappu: “Kyunki woh abhi bhi black and white hai.”

Pappu ki girlfriend: “Tum mujhe kitna pyaar karte ho?”
Pappu: “Jitna data mere phone mein bacha hai.”
GF: “Kitna bacha hai?”
Pappu: “Raat 12 baje reset hoga, tab batata hoon.”

Pappu: “Doctor saab, mujhe roz raat ko lagta hai ki bed ke neeche koi hai.”
Doctor: “1 saal treatment chalega, 20 hazaar lagenge.”
Pappu ne bed ki taange kaat di. Kharcha: 0.

Golu train mein upar wali berth pe so raha tha. TT ne poocha: “Ticket?”
Golu: “Neeche wale uncle ke paas hai, hum ek hi family ke hain.”
Uncle: “Main toh isse jaanta bhi nahi.”
Golu: “Dekha? Aise hi family wale hain.”

Pappu ki mummy: “Beta, jaake dekh doodh ubal gaya kya?”
Pappu: “Haan mummy, 9:15 pe ubal gaya tha.”

Teacher: “Pappu! Class mein so rahe ho?”
Pappu: “Nahi ma'am, dua maang raha tha.”
Teacher: “Kis baat ki?”
Pappu: “Ki aap mujhe na pakdo.”

Pappu: “Papa, mujhe bike chahiye.”
Papa: “Bhagwan ne do pair kis liye diye hain?”
Pappu: “Ek clutch ke liye, ek brake ke liye.”

Police: “Helmet kyun nahi pehna?”
Pappu: “Sir, sar mein kuch hai hi nahi, toh bachaun kya?”

Exam mein question: “Explain in detail.”
Pappu ka answer: “Detail.”

Golu: “Doctor, mujhe bhoolne ki bimari hai.”
Doctor: “Kab se?”
Golu: “Kya kab se?”

Pappu: “Mummy, aaj bus ke peeche daudke 20 rupaye bachaaye.”
Mummy: “Gadhe, taxi ke peeche daudta toh 200 bachte.”

Pappu interview mein:
Interviewer: “Aapki koi achhi aadat?”
Pappu: “Main kabhi jhooth nahi bolta.”
Interviewer: “Wah! Koi buri aadat?”
Pappu: “Main kabhi sach bhi nahi bolta.”

categories.name: Students & Exams
jokes:
Exam se ek raat pehle:
Syllabus — 15 chapter
Padha — index
Confidence — IAS topper level

Teacher: “Ye question pakka aayega.”
Exam mein: Woh chhod ke sab aaya.

Engineering ke 4 saal baad har engineer: “Bhai koi startup idea hai?”
Aur kuch nahi chala toh: “UPSC ki taiyari kar raha hoon.”
UPSC aspirant ka relationship status: Mukherjee Nagar ke saath committed.
Back paper ko “back” isliye bolte hain kyunki woh ex ki tarah peeche peeche aata hi rehta hai.

Exam hall ka sabse bada jhooth: “Bhai maine bhi kuch nahi likha.”
Aur woh 3 supplementary sheet le chuka hota hai.

Online class mein:
Student: “Sir, aapki awaaz nahi aa rahi.”
Sir: “Toh tumhe kaise pata main bol raha hoon?”

Padhne baitha.
Table saaf ki. Pen line se lagaye. Paani laaya. Insta pe “study motivation” ki 40 reels dekhi.
Phir so gaya.

Productive din tha.

Topper aur backbencher mein farak:
Topper ko answer pata hota hai.
Backbencher ko invigilator ka mood.
Trigonometry aaj tak zindagi mein kahin kaam nahi aayi. Na sabzi lene mein, na EMI bharne mein, na breakup sambhalne mein.
Result ke din ghar ka mahaul aisa hota hai jaise IPL ka final hai aur main hi woh player hoon jo duck pe out hua.

Teacher: “Kal parents ko leke aana.”
Main: “Ma'am kal nahi ho payega, papa ko bhi kal unke boss ne bulaya hai.”

Genetics.

Teacher: “Homework kahan hai?”
Student: “Ma'am, ChatGPT se karwaya tha, par usne bola ‘I can't help with that.’”
Kota mein 2 saal reh ke JEE toh nahi nikla, par 14 tarah ki Maggi banana zaroor aa gaya.

Viva mein sir: “Is circuit mein current kahan se kahan jaata hai?”
Student: “Sir, aapke sawaal se mere dimaag tak, aur wahan se seedha bahar.”

Exam ke baad: “Kaisa gaya?” — “Achha gaya.”
Result ke baad: “Paper hi out of syllabus tha.”

Assignment ki last date kal hai.
Aaj raat: “Subah 5 baje uthke kar loonga.”
Subah 5 baje: “Extension maang leta hoon.”

Teacher: “Agar tum mujhe 100 rupaye do aur main tumhe 50 wapas doon, toh mere paas kitne bache?”
Student: “Ma'am, tuition fees jitne.”

categories.name: Love & Breakup
jokes:
Ladka: “Tumhare liye jaan bhi de sakta hoon.”
Ladki: “Toh aaj Zomato se order kar do.”
Ladka: “Yaar mahine ka end hai.”

Jaan free hai, Zomato nahi.

Pehle aashiq chaand taare tod laate the.
Aaj kal ke aashiq “Seen” karke chhod dete hain.

Breakup ke baad ladki: “Main uske bina mar jaungi.”
3 hafte baad: Nayi DP, naya boyfriend, caption: “God's plan ✨”

Ladki: “Main tumhe bhai maanti hoon.”
Ladka: “Theek hai behen, toh pichhle 6 mahine ke Zomato, Uber aur recharge ke paise wapas kar de.”

Dating app bio: “Looking for someone genuine.”
Translation: Pichhla wala bhi aise hi bola tha.
Situationship: woh rishta jisme na shaadi ki guarantee, na breakup ka haq. Bas story pe “seen” ki bheekh.

Girlfriend: “Tum badal gaye ho.”
Boyfriend: “Haan, pehle 3 thi, ab sirf tum ho.”

Ex ko block kiya. Phir unblock karke dekha usne kya status lagaya. Phir block kiya.

Isse achha cardio gym mein bhi nahi hota.

Crush ne pehli baar “hi” bheja.
Maine 2 ghante socha, 47 baar edit kiya, dost se approve karaya, aur finally bheja: “hii”

Pyaar andha hota hai.
Isiliye pados wali aunty sab dekh leti hai.

Ladka: “Tum meri zindagi ho.”
Ladki: “Aww.”
Ladka (mann mein): “Aur zindagi mein problems toh aati hi rehti hain.”

Ladki ka “Main 5 minute mein ready” = 1 ghanta.
Ladke ka “Main 5 minute mein ready” = woh already ready tha, bas chappal dhoondh raha tha.

Breakup ke baad ladka: “Main kabhi kisi se pyaar nahi karunga.”
Agle din: Insta pe nayi ladki ki story pe 🔥 react.

Usne kaha “Tumse achha koi nahi mil sakta.”
Phir usne dhoondhna shuru kiya.
Aur mil bhi gaya.

Love marriage aur arranged marriage mein farak:
Love marriage mein tum khud kuan khod ke koodte ho.
Arranged mein ghar wale dhakka dete hain.

Ladki: “Mujhe kabhi chhodoge toh nahi?”
Ladka: “Kabhi nahi, promise.”

Ladke ne promise nibhaya. Ladki ne pehle chhod diya.

Uski yaad aati hai toh uska last message padh leta hoon:
“Bhaiya, ye wrong number hai.”

Ladki: “Mere liye kya kar sakte ho?”
Ladka: “Kuch bhi.”
Ladki: “Toh mere papa se baat karo.”
Ladka: “Kuch bhi ke alawa kuch bolo.”

Pehli date pe bill maine diya. Doosri pe bhi. Teesri pe usne bola: “Hum friends hi theek hain.”
Us raat maine UPI history dekhi aur ro diya.
Breakup ke baad sad songs aur gym — dono saath mein shuru hote hain, aur 2 hafte mein dono band.

“Mujhe miss karte ho?”
Haan, utna hi jitna main 25 tarikh ke baad apni salary ko karta hoon.

Long distance relationship:
60% video call
30% “network nahi aa raha”
10% shak

categories.name: Aajkal Ka India
jokes: UPI aane ke baad “chhutte nahi hai” wala bahana khatam. Ab toh bhikhari bhi QR code leke ghoomta hai.
Bengaluru mein aadmi ghar se office ke liye nikla aur traffic mein hi uska promotion ho gaya.

Insta reel: “Ye 5 kaam karo, 30 din mein ameer bano.”
Reel banane wala: 2 saal se reel bana raha hai, abhi bhi PG mein rehta hai.

“Bhai crypto le le, 10x hoga.”
2 saal baad: “Bhai long term ke liye hold kar raha hoon.”

Matlab doob gaya.
Delhi mein AQI 450: “Aaj toh mausam saaf hai, saamne wali building dikh rahi hai.”
Swiggy ka “10 minute mein delivery” aur mera “bas nikal raha hoon” — dono ek hi school se padhe hain.

IRCTC Tatkal: 10 baj ke 1 second pe sab ticket khatam.
Aaj tak kisi insaan ko Tatkal ticket milte nahi dekha. Pata nahi kaun log hain ye.

ChatGPT se poocha: “Life ka purpose kya hai?”
Usne 7 points mein jawaab diya.

Mummy se poocha.
Usne ek line mein: “Shaadi kar le.”

Indian gym:
January — 200 log
February — 20 log
March — sirf trainer aur ek uncle jo sirf weighing machine pe khade hote hain.
Mumbai local mein seat milna aur sarkari naukri milna — dono ke liye log janam se taiyari karte hain.

Influencer: “Guys, main bahut simple ladki hoon.”
Peeche: ring light, 3 phone, 2 cameraman aur ek PR team.

Startup founder: “Hum India ka Uber for X bana rahe hain.”
Investor: “X kya hai?”
Founder: “Woh funding milne ke baad decide karenge.”
Jio ke aane ke baad Indians ne ek hi cheez seekhi: kaam kuch nahi, data poora khatam.
Gurgaon mein do cheezein free milti hain: Startup ka office tour aur barish ke baad sadak pe swimming pool.
Amazon pe product ka review: “Product achha hai, delivery boy bhi handsome tha. 5 star.” — Aunty ji.
Har Indian ki 3 subscription: Netflix dost ki, Hotstar bhai ki, Prime ex ki — jiska password ab tak change nahi hua.
Indian uncle ka Facebook comment: “Very nice beta. God bless. Kya kar rahe ho aajkal? Shaadi kab hai?” — ek post pe 3 sawaal.

AI aayega, sabki naukri le jayega.
Main: “Bhai meri naukri le ja, par EMI bhi saath le jaana.”

Uber driver: “Sir location bhejiye.”
Maine bheji.
Driver: “Sir, aap hi aa jao, main samajh nahi pa raha main kahan hoon.”
Zomato pe “Healthy” filter lagaya, 10 minute salad dekhe, phir chupchaap biryani order kar di.

Online shopping:
Photo mein — iPhone jaisa phone.
Delivery mein — iPhone ka cover.

“Bhai main digital detox pe hoon.”
Ye usne Instagram story pe bataya.

Bengaluru mein 2BHK ka rent 45,000.
Bhai ye ghar hai ya IPL franchise?
Cashback offer: 2000 kharch karo, 3 rupaye cashback paao, aur upar se “Congratulations! You won!” wala tamasha.
Aadhaar card ki photo dekh ke lagta hai sarkar ne saath mein criminal record bhi bana diya hai.

Pehle “busy hoon” ka matlab kaam hota tha.
Ab busy matlab: “Reels dekh raha hoon, disturb mat karo.”

categories.name: Rishtedaar & Shaadi
jokes:
Har shaadi mein rishtedaar bolte the: “Beta, agla number tera.”
Maine bhi unhe ek funeral mein yahi bola.
Ab woh mujhse shaadi ke baare mein nahi poochhte.

Aunty: “Beta, salary kitni hai?”
Main: “Aunty, aapki beti se zyada aur aapke bete se toh bahut zyada.”

Indian shaadi:
Budget — 30 lakh
Khaana — 150 dishes
Rishtedaar ka review — “Paneer thanda tha.”
Fufaji ko shaadi mein naraz hona hi hai. Agar fufaji khush hain, toh samjho shaadi fake hai.

Shaadi card: “Aapki upasthiti hi hamara upahaar hai.”
Translation: Lifafe mein kam se kam 1100 daalna, list bana rahe hain.

Rishta wale: “Ladka kya karta hai?”
“Startup hai.”
Ladki ki mummy: “Matlab berozgaar hai, par confidence ke saath.”

DJ ke paas 5000 gaane hain.
Uncle ji 30 saal se ek hi request kar rahe hain: “Bhaiya, Nagin wala bajao.”

Indian rishtedaar ki 3 stages:
Padhai mein — “Kitne number aaye?”
Naukri mein — “Package kitna hai?”
Shaadi ke baad — “Good news kab?”

Ye cycle sirf maut pe khatam hoti hai.

Rishtedaar aaye: “Bas 5 minute ke liye aaye hain.”
3 din baad bhi wahi bol rahe the.

Arranged marriage meeting:
Ladka: “Aapki hobbies?”
Ladki: “Cooking, reading, travelling.”
Ladka: “Wow, meri bhi.”

Dono jhooth bol rahe the. Asli hobby dono ki ek hi thi: raat 3 baje tak reels.
Shaadi mein sabse zyada mehnat dulha-dulhan nahi karte. Woh ladka karta hai jo 4 ghante se photographer ke peeche “bhaiya ek photo meri bhi” bol raha hai.

Mausi: “Kitna patla ho gaya hai, khaana nahi milta kya?”
1 saal baad wahi mausi: “Kitna mota ho gaya hai, thoda kam kha.”

Mausi ko sirf comment karna hai, weight se koi lena dena nahi.
Dulhe ke dost baraat mein itna naachte hain jaise unki khud ki azaadi khatam nahi ho rahi, kisi aur ki ho rahi hai — aur sach mein ho bhi rahi hoti hai.
Shaadi mein ek aadmi hamesha hota hai jo kisi ko nahi jaanta, koi use nahi jaanta, par khaana sabse pehle wahi khaata hai.

Teen din ki shaadi, har din alag outfit.
Dulhe ke paas: ek suit aur teen alag mood.

Baraat 3 ghante late.
Ladki wale: “Itni der?”
Ladke wale: “Dulhe ke dost abhi tak Nagin dance se bahar nahi nikle.”
Rishtedaar ki shaadi ki har photo mein mera expression: “Mujhe yahan zabardasti laaya gaya hai.”
Destination wedding ka asli matlab rishtedaaron ke liye: “Udaipur chal rahe hain” = 3 din free ka hotel aur buffet.

Sasur ji: “Beta, meri beti khush hai na?”
Damaad: “Papa ji, bahut khush hai. Aapka credit card abhi bhi uske paas hai.”

categories.name: Cricket & IPL
jokes: India-Pakistan match ke din ghar mein sirf do cheezein hoti hain: 140 crore coach aur ek bechara TV.
Har Indian ke andar ek Dhoni chhupa hai jo kaam last over mein hi karta hai. Bas trophy kabhi nahi aati.

IPL ke time papa “Beta, padhai kar” nahi bolte.
Woh poochhte hain: “Beta, score kya hua?”

Uncle TV ke saamne: “Arre straight bat se khel!”
Uncle ne aakhri baar bat 1987 mein pakda tha.

RCB fans ne 17 saal trophy ka intezaar kiya.
Itna sabr toh UPSC aspirants mein bhi nahi hota.

Gully cricket ke rules:
1. Jiska bat, woh captain.
2. Jiski ball, woh kabhi out nahi hoga.
3. Jisne khidki todi, woh sabse pehle bhaagega.
Gully cricket ka “one tip one hand” rule ICC ke rules se bhi zyada strict hai.
Match fixing pe bhi itna drama nahi hota jitna gully cricket mein “Ye out nahi tha!” pe hota hai.

Dream11 pe team banayi. 11 mein se 9 player match mein khele hi nahi.
Itni achhi selection toh selectors bhi nahi karte.
Match wale din office mein: 40% logon ki dadi bimaar, 60% logon ka internet slow.

Uncle: “Main pehle hi bol raha tha chauka aayega!”
Uncle pichhli 5 ball pe bhi yahi bol rahe the.

Last over, 12 run chahiye.
Poora mohalla bhagwan ko yaad kar raha hai.
Aur main sirf ye soch raha hoon ki remote kisne chhupaya.

categories.name: Double Meaning 18+
jokes:
Patni: “Aaj raat jaldi aa jaana.”
Pati: “Kyun?”
Patni: “Kuch naya try karna hai.”

Pati office se bhaag ke aaya.
Patni: “Ye dekho, nayi recipe — lauki ka halwa.”

Ladki: “Tumhara kitna bada hai?”
Ladka sharma gaya.
Ladki: “Arre, phone ka screen pooch rahi hoon. 6.7 inch hai kya?”

Suhaagraat pe dulha: “Jaan, light band kar doon?”
Dulhan: “Haan, aur khidki bhi band kar do.”
Dulha: “Kyun?”
Dulhan: “Pichhli baar pados wale ne dekh liya tha.”

Pati: “Aaj tumhe kuch special dikhata hoon.”
Patni: “Itna sa special?”
Pati: “Jaanu, ring hai. Diamond wali.”

Patni: “Tum toh 2 minute mein hi…”
Pati: “Kya karoon, Maggi ka packet hi aisa aata hai.”

Pados wali bhabhi: “Bhaiya, aapke paas pump hai? Mera bahut dheela pad gaya hai.”
Bhaiya ne 10 second socha, phir bole: “Cycle ka ya scooty ka?”

Suhaagraat ke agle din dulhan nashte pe: “Mummy ji, inhe toh sab kuch aata hai!”
Saas ne shak se bete ki taraf dekha.
Beta: “Mummy… YouTube.”

Pati ne raat ko biwi ko ek glass paani aur Disprin di.
Biwi: “Par mere sar mein dard nahi hai.”
Pati: “Bas yahi sunna tha.”

Dukaan pe ladki: “Bhaiya, ye bahut tight hai, thoda bada dikhaiye na.”
Peeche line mein khade uncle ne apni patni ki taraf dekha aur lambi saans li.

Ladka: “Bhabhi, bhaiya ghar pe hain?”
Bhabhi: “Nahi.”
Ladka: “Toh main aa jaaun?”
Bhabhi: “Aa jao. Tumhare bhaiya bhi yahi poochh ke pados wali ke ghar gaye hain.”

Gym trainer: “Aunty, roz 20 minute upar-neeche kijiye.”
Aunty: “Kyaaa?”
Trainer: “Squats, aunty. Squats.”

Pati: “Jaldi idhar aao, bahut bada hai, dekh ke hairaan ho jaogi.”
Patni: “Phir se wahi?”
Pati: “Bijli ka bill, jaanu.”

Aurat doctor se: “Doctor saab, mere pati neend mein bahut bolte hain.”
Doctor: “Dawai de deta hoon, bolna band ho jayega.”
Aurat: “Nahi doctor, aisi dawai do ki saaf-saaf bolein. Ladki ka naam samajh nahi aata.”

Mard ki zindagi ke 3 phase:
20 ki umar — roz.
35 ki umar — weekend pe.
55 ki umar — “Jai Shri Ram, so jao.”

Biwi: “Tumhe pata hai, mere liye size matter karta hai.”
Pati ka chehra utar gaya.
Biwi: “Diamond ka, jaanu.”

Pehli raat dulha: “Main tumhe zindagi bhar khush rakhunga.”
Dulhan: “Zindagi bhar ki baat baad mein, pehle aaj raat ka plan batao.”

Teacher: “Jiska ho gaya, woh khada ho jaaye.”
Pappu baitha raha.
Teacher: “Tumhara nahi hua?”
Pappu: “Ma'am, ho toh gaya… par class mein khada hone mein sharam aa rahi hai.”

Ladki: “Mujhe lamba aur mota pasand hai.”
Saheli: “Haaye, kya?”
Ladki: “Pen, pagal. Exam mein grip achhi aati hai.”

Naye shaadi-shuda dost se poocha: “Shaadi ke baad sabse bada change?”
Bola: “Pehle 'Netflix and chill' ka matlab kuch aur tha. Ab Netflix pe biwi serial dekhti hai aur main chill nahi kar sakta.”

Doctor: “Aapko roz subah 'exercise' karni chahiye.”
Uncle: “Karta hoon doctor saab.”
Doctor: “Kab?”
Uncle: “Jab aunty mandir jaati hain, tab TV pe exercise wala channel dekhta hoon.”

Biwi: “Shaadi ke baad tum romantic kyun nahi rahe?”
Pati: “Kaun bola? Roz raat ko tumhare liye mehnat karta hoon.”
Biwi: “Kab?”
Pati: “Jab machhar maarta hoon, taaki tum chain se so sako.”

Ladka medical store pe dheere se: “Bhaiya woh… woh wala dena.”
Dukaandaar zor se: “KAUNSA? Strawberry ya chocolate flavour?”
Peeche khadi mohalle ki aunty ne mummy ko call kar diya.

Doctor: “Itni kamzori kyun?”
Pati: “Doctor saab, nayi-nayi shaadi hui hai.”
Doctor: “Ahh, samajh gaya.”
Pati: “Nahi doctor, biwi roz shopping le jaati hai, saare bag main uthata hoon.”

Bhabhi: “Devar ji, raat ko akele dar lagta hai.”
Devar: “Main aa jaaun?”
Bhabhi: “Nahi, apne bhaiya ki torch de do.”

Patni: “Tumne kabhi mujhe dhokha diya?”
Pati: “Kabhi nahi.”
Patni: “Toh phone mein ‘Plumber Ramesh’ ki DP ladki ki kyun hai?”

Uncle 60 saal ke: “Main abhi bhi jawaan hoon.”
Aunty: “Haan, raat 9 baje tak.”

Pati: “Jaanu, aaj mood hai.”
Patni: “Mood toh mera bhi hai… sone ka.”

Honeymoon se dost ko call:
Dost: “Kaisa chal raha hai?”
Dulha: “Bhai 3 din se kamre se bahar nahi nikle.”
Dost: “Waah sher!”
Dulha: “Biwi ne chaabi kho di hai.”

Pati: “Aaj raat kuch naughty karte hain.”
Patni (sharmaate hue): “Kya?”
Pati: “Bina bataaye tumhari mummy ke ghar chalte hain aur unke fridge ki saari mithai kha jaate hain.”

Biwi: “Shaadi ke pehle tum mujhe dekh ke kya sochte the?”
Pati: “Wahi jo tum ab soch rahi ho.”
Biwi: “Main toh soch rahi hoon kal sabzi kya banau.”
Pati: “Haan, wahi toh shaadi hai.”

categories.name: One Liners
jokes: Paisa sab kuch nahi hota. Par jitna bhi hota hai, mere paas nahi hota.
Main diet pe hoon. Abhi tak 3 din kam ho gaye.
Zindagi mein do cheezein kabhi wapas nahi aati: guzra hua waqt aur woh pen jo kisi ko “ek minute” ke liye diya tha.

Log kehte hain paisa ped pe nahi ugta.
Toh phir bank ki branch kyun hoti hai?
Purani jeans mein 500 ka note mila. Pehle bahut khushi hui. Phir yaad aaya ye note demonetization se pehle ka hai.
Agar mehnat se hi sab milta, toh gadha jungle ka raja hota.
Main itna aalsi hoon ki sapne mein bhi baaki log daud rahe hote hain aur main baith ke dekh raha hota hoon.

Doctor: “Aapke paas bas 6 mahine hain.”
Patient: “Doctor saab, main bill nahi bhar paaunga.”
Doctor: “Theek hai, 6 mahine aur.”
Mera bank balance aur mera crush — dono mujhe dekh ke ek hi baat kehte hain: “Tumse na ho payega.”
Kehte hain sabr ka phal meetha hota hai. 26 saal se sabr kar raha hoon, abhi tak ek kela bhi nahi mila.

Roz raat sochta hoon kal se jaldi uthunga.
Kal ko ye baat pata hai, isliye woh kabhi aata hi nahi.

Mere paas bungalow hai, Ferrari hai, yacht hai…
GTA mein.
Alarm ka snooze button matlab: “Main zinda hoon, bas mujhe chhod do.”
Log kehte hain apne sapno ka peecha karo. Isliye main aur so gaya.
Duniya gol hai. Isiliye jo aaj tumhe chhod ke gaya, kal woh kisi aur ko bhi chhod ke wapas aayega… udhaar maangne.
Bachpan mein sochta tha bada hoke bahut paise kamaunga. Ab bada ho gaya hoon, aur bachpan wali baat pe hansi aati hai.
Mujhe kisi se jalan nahi hoti. Bas jab dusre khush hote hain toh thoda acidity ho jaati hai.
Life ek jalebi ki tarah hai — seedhi kabhi nahi hoti, par meethi hai toh kha rahe hain.
Kuch log itne seedhe hote hain ki unhe jalebi bhi line mein lagi hui chahiye.
Har Monday main ek naya insaan banta hoon. Tuesday tak purana wala wapas aa jaata hai.
Mera weight aur meri salary kabhi ek direction mein nahi chalte.
Pareshaani mein muskurana seekh liya toh log samajhte hain dimaag hil gaya hai.
Neend aur breakup — dono raat 3 baje hi sabse zyada kharab hote hain.
Mujhe ghamand nahi hai. Ghamand karne layak kuch hai hi nahi.
